subject: Error on deploying apps but works  well on local machine.

messages.author: 78ef51af74a486f1
messages.subject: Error on deploying apps but works  well on local machine.
parts:
I cannot deploy my app to Shinyapp.io, the Error is :

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘KoNLP’:
 .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'KoNLP', details:
  call: if (all((localeToCharset()[1] == c("UTF-8", "CP949", "EUC-KR")) ==
  error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/KoNLP’
################################# End Task Log #################################
ERROR: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 500101545 failed: Error building image: Error building KoNLP (0.80.1). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


please check my problem. This task is very important to me, but im stucked..
